purpose: Diagnostic content-completion score following the earlier private-material pilot; not an official benchmark score
single_edited: 10 only if the decision is suspicious and at least one directly verifiable relation affected by the introduced edit is correctly identified; otherwise 0
single_control: 10 for no_clear_evidence with no false anomaly claim; otherwise 0. Insufficient is reported as abstention and receives 0 completion points
paired_edited: 10 times the fraction of introduced fields with correct before/after values and correct row/column binding. Each cell is a separate field even when its value repeats in another column
paired_control: 10 only if no business-field changes are reported; otherwise 0
extra_claims: Record separately; the recall-based content score does not penalize extra paired claims. Also report field precision and complete-question rate
boxes: Bounding boxes are saved and may support adjudication; no box accuracy score is included in the primary content-completion score
adjudication: Root Codex manually checks answers against deterministic generator truth and decimal arithmetic; this is not independent expert annotation
comparability: The public pilot has different sources, image resolution and task mix from the earlier 30-question pilot; do not infer a model improvement from raw score differences
